description: 1. Create PIPELINE.md at ~/Documents/proyectos/genome-qc/PIPELINE.md (NOT in the agent workspace). It must have the proprietary header block (# PIPELINE —, # Proyecto:, # Objetivo:, # Creado: YYYY-MM-DD). It must contain exactly 5 steps all with [PENDING] status. Every single step must have both 'engine:' and 'verify:' fields. Steps 1 and 2 must use 'parallel:' field with a list of sibling step numbers (e.g. parallel: [2] / parallel: [1]). Steps 3, 4, 5 must use 'depends_on:' referencing the correct prerequisite step numbers. 2. Create HEARTBEAT.md at ~/.openclaw/workspace-agent-bio-01/HEARTBEAT.md (NOT inside the project repo). It must have the '# HEARTBEAT —' header, the '⚠️ NUNCA modifiques este archivo' immutability warning, a '## Pipeline activo:' section pointing to the PIPELINE.md with an absolute path (~/Documents/proyectos/genome-qc/PIPELINE.md), a heartbeat protocol section (numbered steps), and a Zombie Detection section. 3. Make at least one git commit in the genome-qc repo whose message follows the format 'pipeline/genome-qc/step-N: <title>'.
